title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
key_facts: Vercel data published on Thursday (15 Oct 2026) shows that within two weeks of launch Jev was used by 35% of paid teams, nearly double the reach of the second most popular model, Sonnet 5.5 (TechCrunch).
According to Vercel's data it is the fastest adoption a model has seen in its first two weeks; its makers are TypeSafe AI.

Jev was published in limited release on 15 September and is a lightweight model that chooses between a few predetermined outputs, which makes it cheaper and faster than models such as Sonnet for classifying large amounts of data.
The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter, a limited view that is at risk of undercounting labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic that offer their own APIs.
Vercel was an early adopter, using Jev to replace GPT-6 Luna for classifying harmful commands.
Competing offerings from OpenAI and Amazon, among others, followed Jev's buzz.
Open source models now account for more than 70% of tokens processed through Vercel's gateway and nearly 25% of total spend; spending on frontier labs has grown tenfold.
quote_evidence: Vercel data published on Thursday shows that, within two weeks of its launch, the buzzy decision model was being used by 35% of paid teams, with nearly double the reach of the second most popular model, Sonnet 5.5.
Jev has become the fastest adopted AI model ever — at least by some measures.
why_it_matters_hint: First hard usage figures behind the buzz around Jev, from one platform's gateway that sees only part of the market.
event_date: Vercel data published Thursday 15 Oct 2026; Jev released in limited form 15 Sep 2026
notes: The article says 'within two weeks of its launch' and also 'limited release on September 15'; the two-week window is Vercel's measure and its start date is not given, so the summary says 'in its first two weeks' as Vercel's data does. Earlier coverage: our 10 Oct 2026 edition (TypeSafe AI's $870 million funding round); the 15 Oct pool had a Jev 1.14 release item that was pool only.
